scopeNote: Byte-for-byte copy of audited src/NFTStaker.sol EXCEPT immutable priceScale + constructor guard/assign + single `latestPrice = latestPrice * priceScale` multiply at L435. Findings that apply equally to the audited NFTStaker baseline are demoted to confidence:low (baseline-inherited) unless they intersect the priceScale delta; none intersect it.
priceScaleArithmeticVerdict: CLEAN. No tool (Slither divide-before-multiply / incorrect-exp / overflow, Aderyn, Semgrep) flagged the new priceScale path (L435 `latestPrice = latestPrice * priceScale`, L440 `totalStaked * latestPrice`, L455 `S.mulDiv(targetAPY, APY_PRECISION)`). The two arithmetic detectors that did fire (divide-before-multiply, incorrect-exp) are confined to lib/immutable/openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol (root cause out of scope). The priceScale multiply executes in a checked ^0.8.20 context (bare `*`, no unchecked block) so any overflow reverts rather than wraps. NOTE: tools cannot reason about the documented overflow bound (totalStaked*latestPrice*priceScale <= 2^256 for priceScale<=1e12) or about precision loss from the floor `price.mulDiv(1e18,r)` happening BEFORE the priceScale multiply -- these are deferred to econ-scanner / code-scanner, not a SAST gap.

findings.description: External call dispatcherHook.pull() in _syncBudget() precedes writes to user.rewardDebt / user.amount / totalStaked / accRewardPerShare in stake (L485-487), unstake (L507-509), claim (L526). Aderyn independently flags the ERC1155 safeTransferFrom at L484 as state-change-after-external-call (HIGH).
findings.rationale: Baseline-inherited: identical pattern exists in audited NFTStaker.sol; all three entrypoints carry OZ nonReentrant. The external callee (dispatcherHook.pull / ERC1155 receiver hooks) is in-system, not arbitrary. Does NOT intersect the priceScale delta. Kept at low confidence for recall since the file is newly in scope; expect dedup to fold against the NFTStaker baseline.

findings.description: Tuple destructure of nftMinter.configs(dispatcherIndex) ignores fields 0 and 3, consuming only price (field 1) and growthBasisPoints (field 2). The consumed `price` feeds directly into the new priceScale path.
findings.rationale: INTERSECTS the priceScale delta loosely (this is the read whose `price` is multiplied by priceScale at L435), so kept rather than dropped. The ignored fields are intentionally unused per spec; deliberate destructure, not a bug. Severity downgraded in practice to QA -- flagged here for traceability that the priceScale input originates from this unchecked-shape external read.

findings.description: block.timestamp used in runway/accrual comparisons: windowEnd boundary (L360, L610, L637), lastRewardTime gating (L355, L609, L634), currentRewardRate cutoff (L622), windowEnd = now + runway (L461). Time-driven emission schedule.
findings.rationale: Per static-analyzer policy these timestamp detectors are NOT dropped for this time-driven suite (reward accrual over windowEnd / lastRewardTime is load-bearing). However this logic is byte-for-byte identical to the audited NFTStaker baseline and does not intersect the priceScale delta. Retained at low confidence for dedup to reconcile against baseline.
